Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate closely with Art, Design, and Engineering teams to establish and maintain production pipelines and quality standards for performance animation, ensuring consistency in character emotions and visual storytelling.

  • Define production guidelines and animation standards for facial performances, dialogue scenes, and character acting, driving scalable and efficient content creation workflows while continuously improving quality and productivity.

  • Strong industrialized production mindset. Experience establishing animation standards, optimizing workflows, and improving team-wide delivery quality is highly preferred.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced production environment. Prior experience in film production studios or cinematic teams is a plus.

title: Senior/Lead Gameplay Animator - 3C & FPS

description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior or Lead Gameplay Animator with strong AAA FPS experience to help shape responsive, compelling character movement and moment-to-moment gameplay.
With a focus on Character, Controls, and Camera (3C), you will combine animation craft with practical implementation skills to develop features from early prototypes through final in-game polish. Working closely with gameplay designers, programmers, and technical animators, you will help ensure that character animation, player input, and camera behavior work together to deliver a cohesive player experience.
This is a hands-on role with meaningful ownership of gameplay animation features and opportunities to influence the systems and workflows behind them.

What You’ll Do

  • Own gameplay animation features from concept to completion, including reference gathering, prototyping, asset creation, engine integration, debugging, and polish.
  • Create high-quality character movement and action animations, covering locomotion, directional changes, stance transitions, traversal, and combat interactions.
  • Contribute to first-person animation and its relationship with full-body movement, weapon handling, and camera feedback.
  • Partner with designers and programmers to refine movement responsiveness, action timing, transitions, and interruption behavior while preserving believable weight and physicality.
  • Build and refine animation graphs, state machines, blend setups, and animation layers within the project’s engine and tools.
  • Use keyframe animation and motion-capture workflows to deliver animation that meets gameplay and visual requirements.
  • Evaluate your work in playable builds, identify the causes of animation issues, and collaborate across disciplines to resolve them.
  • Work with technical animation and engineering teams to improve workflows and address runtime, asset, and production constraints.
  • For Lead-level appointments, guide feature planning, establish animation quality benchmarks, provide actionable feedback, and mentor teammates while continuing to create and implement animation directly.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience creating and implementing gameplay animation for AAA first-person shooters, with clear ownership of features or animation systems.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating body mechanics, weight, timing, posing, and a clear understanding of responsive gameplay animation.
  • Practical experience taking animation assets into a game engine and iterating on their behavior in playable builds.
  • Working knowledge of animation graphs, state machines, blending, additive animation, and gameplay-driven transitions.
  • An understanding of how character movement, player controls, and camera behavior influence each other and shape game feel.
  • Proficiency in professional animation tools, with experience in keyframe animation and motion-capture editing.
  • The ability to investigate animation problems, explain their likely causes, and work with design and engineering partners to deliver effective solutions.
  • Strong ownership, clear communication, and a consistent record of delivering work within production constraints.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Hands-on experience on recent AAA FPS productions with a high standard of player movement, first-person animation, and combat responsiveness.
  • Direct involvement in establishing or evolving 3C animation systems, particularly from early development through production.
  • Additional experience on AAA action or action-adventure games involving sophisticated traversal, melee combat, or character interactions.
  • A technical animation background that enables you to understand and resolve issues across animation assets, runtime systems, and gameplay logic.
  • Experience with techniques such as inverse kinematics, motion matching, procedural animation, motion warping, or animation retargeting.
  • Scripting or tool-development experience that improves animation workflows and iteration speed.
  • Experience maintaining consistency between first-person presentation and third-person character animation.

Senior / Lead Expectations
Senior: Independently own complex animation features, make sound creative and technical decisions, and drive implementation and polish with cross-disciplinary partners.
Lead: Combine strong individual delivery with the ability to guide others, align animation work with gameplay goals, and maintain quality across interconnected features.
We also welcome high-potential candidates with relevant production experience and exceptional portfolios who demonstrate the ability to grow into broader ownership. Level will reflect demonstrated capability and contribution.
Location & Working Arrangement
Relocation to China is preferred. Remote arrangements may be considered based on location, time-zone compatibility, and collaboration needs.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity:
NetEase is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity in its workforce. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We also comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding applicants with criminal histories. If you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any part of the application process, please email globaltalent@service.netease.com.

Data Privacy 

In order to administer our recruiting process, we collect and process certain information including personal information. For further information on what personal information we collect, how we use it and process it, please see our Candidate Privacy Notice.

Ability to flexibly leverage foundation models, Agents, and other tools to solve business problems. Proven experience in video/image model orchestration and automated workflow construction is preferred.
  3. Business Acumen: Familiarity with overseas growth ad creative workflows (in-feed video ads, TikTok/YouTube/Meta ad assets, landing page and campaign page visuals, etc.). Strong ability to deconstruct narrative pacing, camera language, audio-visual synergy, layout composition, color systems, visual hierarchy, and image-copy coordination.   6. Industry Insight: Continuously track technology and product advances in image/video generation, design Agents, and intelligent workflows. Keenly assess how technological boundaries can expand growth efficiency.

title: Group Function - Privacy Legal Counsel
description:
About the Company：

NetEase, Inc. (Nasdaq: NTES and HKEX: 9999) is a global powerhouse in the Internet and online game industry, with a market capitalization of $80+ billion and more than 25,000 employees worldwide. The NetEase group encompasses a range of innovative businesses centered around content creation, including:

NetEase Games, one of the largest and most renowned game developers worldwide by size, revenue and game offerings. Over the years, NetEase Games has focused on developing high quality content and providing the best experience for gamers around the world;

  • Youdao (NYSE: DAO), a majority-controlled subsidiary of NetEase, Inc. and China’s leading technology-focused intelligent learning company;
  • Cloud Music (HKEX: 9899), a majority-controlled subsidiary of NetEase, Inc. and China’s leading online music content community;
  • Yanxuan, NetEase’s private label consumer lifestyle brand; and
  • Other innovative businesses, including, among others, an online payment platform and to-B AI technology solutions provider.

About this Role:

We are seeking a mid-level Group Privacy Legal Counsel with 4–8 years of experience to join our legal team. You will manage global privacy compliance, mitigate data risks, and support cross-functional teams on privacy-by-design initiatives, reporting to NetEase’s Head of Privacy & Data Protection. You will also support cybersecurity risk management and compliance with emerging AI regulations and related matters.

This position is part of the Group International Legal department which oversees legal matters for the NetEase group (ex-China) and coordinates with the legal teams within each division of the group.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Compliance Management: Maintain and update global privacy policies, notices, and internal frameworks for our global business units, including online games, music streaming, e-commerce, e-sports, intelligent learning, and others.
  • Product Counseling: Work with product and engineering teams to implement privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default and responsible AI principles into product lifecycles.
  • Risk Assessments: Provide legal guidance on cross-border data transfers and data localization requirements and conduct, review, and document Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs).
  • Contract Management: Draft, negotiate, and review Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) as well as the data privacy-related provisions in a wide range of commercial agreements with third parties, including IP licensing and software co-development agreements.
  • Incident Response: Investigate potential data/cybersecurity incidents and manage regulatory notification obligations.
  • Employee Training: Design and deliver privacy and AI awareness training across global offices.
  • Regulatory Monitoring: Track emerging privacy and AI laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, EU AI Act, EU Digital Services Act, local regulations) and update frameworks.
  • Outside Counsel: Collaborate and coordinate with outside counsel across various jurisdictions.
  • Other: Take on other relevant duties as assigned and commensurate with your ability.

  Requirements:

  • Qualification: Qualified lawyer in the U.S., Hong Kong, Singapore, UK and/or Canada.
  • Experience: 4 to 8 years of legal practice focused on privacy and data protection, cybersecurity and emerging technologies.
  • Industry Background: Mix of major law firm training and in-house corporate experience preferred.
  • Tech Literacy: Understanding of data flows and mapping, cloud computing, and modern IT architecture, and familiarity or interest in the interactive entertainment industry in general.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese. This role supports business operations across multiple regions and business units and requires frequent collaboration with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and cross-functional teams at NetEase's headquarters in China.
  • Location:  Preferably Hong Kong or Singapore.

Preferred Skills & Certifications:

  • Certifications: CIPP/E, CIPP/US, or CIPM designations are highly desirable.
  • Self-starter: Demonstrates high self-initiative and can work with teams to drive projects to pragmatic solutions.
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex legal requirements into actionable business advice.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Growth mindset that can thrive in a dynamic, cross-border environment, while working effectively across different disciplines, cultures, and time zones.

Fair Employment Practices
At NetEase, we are committed to fair employment practices. We welcome applications from all individuals, irrespective of age, gender, race, religion, marital status and family responsibilities, or disability.

title: Group Function - Public Company Compliance
description:
About the Company:

NetEase, Inc. (Nasdaq: NTES and HKEX: 9999) is a global powerhouse in the Internet and video game industry, with a market capitalization of $70+ billion and more than 25,000 employees worldwide. The NetEase group encompasses a range of innovative businesses centered around content creation, including:

  • NetEase Games, one of the largest and most renowned game developers worldwide by size, revenue and game offerings. Over the years, NetEase Games has focused on developing high quality content and providing the best experience for gamers around the world;
  • Youdao (NYSE: DAO), a majority-controlled subsidiary of NetEase, Inc. and China’s leading technology-focused intelligent learning company;
  • Cloud Music (HKEX: 9899), a majority-controlled subsidiary of NetEase, Inc. and China’s leading online music content community;
  • Yanxuan, NetEase’s private label consumer lifestyle brand; and
  • Other innovative businesses, including, among others, an online payment platform and to-B technology solutions.

About the Role

We are seeking a junior to mid-level legal counsel to join our in-house legal team supporting the public company compliance work of NetEase, Inc. which is dual-listed on Nasdaq and The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (HKEX), with additional subsidiaries separately listed in Hong Kong or the U.S.

You will take hands-on responsibility for the day-to-day securities filings, periodic reporting, and ongoing listing compliance and corporate governance obligations of the parent company and its listed subsidiaries.

This is an excellent opportunity for a securities/capital markets lawyer to develop expertise across two major regulatory regimes within a multi-listed corporate structure, while also gaining valuable insight into a fascinating and fast-evolving industry. You will collaborate closely with our finance, treasury, transactions and IR departments and other legal team members.

Location

  • Hong Kong or Singapore.

Key Responsibilities

Ongoing Disclosure & Regulatory Filings

  • Prepare and submit routine HKEX filings and announcements, including next day disclosure returns and monthly returns.
  • Handle disclosure of interests filings under Part XV of the SFO for the group and its listed subsidiaries.
  • Prepare U.S. beneficial ownership reports (Schedules 13D/13G) and Section 16 filings (Forms 3, 4, and 5).
  • Maintain the group filing calendar and monitor deadlines across all listed entities.

Periodic & Annual Reporting

  • Assist with periodic reports across both regimes: HK annual/interim reports and results announcements; and the U.S. annual reports and earnings announcements.
  • Run the D&O questionnaire process and collate responses from directors and management.

Corporate Governance, Board & Shareholder Matters

  • Support board and committee processes, including agendas, meeting materials, resolutions, and minutes.
  • Help prepare AGM (and other general meeting) circulars, notices, proxy forms, and proxy statements.
  • Assist with compliance under the HKEX Corporate Governance Code and applicable U.S. standards.
  • Maintain corporate governance policies and files, including those relating to inside information, securities dealing / insider trading, and related-party transactions.

Advisory, Training & Coordination

  • Prepare and maintain training materials for directors, officers, and employees on securities law compliance, disclosure obligations and a wide range of related topics.
  • Support the assessment of notifiable and connected and monitor inside information disclosure obligations.
  • Coordinate disclosure across listed entities and liaise with external counsel, auditors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Conduct legal research and support ad hoc corporate transactions and special projects as needed.

Qualifications

  • Qualified lawyer admitted in Hong Kong or a U.S. jurisdiction.
  • Approximately 2–5 years PQE, gained at a reputable law firm and/or in-house legal position.
  • Solid working knowledge of the HKEX Listing Rules is essential. 
  • Genuine interest in building deep expertise across both the HK and U.S. regulatory regimes within a multi-listed structure.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a flexible and approachable manner.
  • Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is a significant plus as this role involves regular collaboration with Mandarin speaking stakeholders.

Fair Employment Practices
At NetEase, we are committed to fair employment practices. We welcome applications from all individuals, irrespective of age, gender, race, religion, marital status and family responsibilities, or disability.

title: Localization Linguist
description:
Responsibilities

  1. ZH→EN Transcreation & Quality Assurance: Rewrite storylines, character dialogue, event and quest copy, and UI text from Simplified Chinese into natural, idiomatic English, faithfully recreating tone, emotion, humor, pacing, and character voice.

  1. Native or near-native English speaker with a solid foundation in writing, editing, and proofreading; fluent in reading and writing Chinese, able to directly comprehend and interpret nuances in the Chinese source text.

  2. 3+ years of experience in game localization or a related field; must have been involved end-to-end in the launch and ongoing live-ops updates of at least one long-term operated title.

  3. Familiarity with the full localization workflow and tooling: CAT/TMS, terminology management, translation memory, LQA processes, and defect management.

  4. Strong cultural sensitivity and editorial judgment — not satisfied with literal translation; able to propose better idiomatic rewrites and articulate the rationale.

  • Familiarity with casual games or female-oriented content expression.

title: Social Media User Growth Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a product operations professional with strong monetization and campaign management capabilities. You will be responsible for driving user acquisition, revenue growth, and marketing initiatives across overseas markets. This role requires close collaboration with Product, Marketing, Sales, Design, and Engineering teams to deliver measurable business results.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Lead product monetization initiatives, including pricing plans, promotions, conversion funnels, and lifecycle operations.

2. Plan and execute online and offline campaigns, product launches, user growth programs, and co-marketing initiatives.

3. Develop localized operating strategies based on overseas market insights to improve activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and revenue.

4. Own the full lifecycle of events and campaigns, including planning, resource coordination, channel promotion, execution, and post-campaign analysis.

5. Develop and manage overseas channels, communities, content platforms, and partnership resources.

6. Track key operational metrics, analyze campaign and monetization performance, and continuously improve ROI.

7. Gather user feedback and market insights to support product improvements and enhance user experience.

8. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure projects are delivered efficiently and effectively.

**Requirements**

1. 1–3 years of experience in product operations, monetization, growth, marketing, or event operations; experience in international markets is preferred.

2. In-depth understanding of user growth, campaign planning, channel operations, content operations, and paid conversion.

3. Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify problems and develop data-driven optimization plans.

4. Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to independently drive projects from planning to execution.

5. Proven ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Notion AI, AI analytics, or automation tools.

6. Fluent in both English and Chinese, with the ability to communicate in meetings and handle daily written communication in both languages.

7. Strong ownership, execution, learning, and problem-solving skills.

8. Comfortable working on multiple regions and familiar with cultural nuances and behavioral differences across regions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

1. Experience using remote desktop or remote control products such as AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or Chrome Remote Desktop.

2. Proven success in product monetization, paid conversion, or revenue growth.

3. Experience with overseas product launches, channel acquisition, community operations, or growth campaigns.

4. Experience working with SaaS, productivity tools, B2B, or B2C products.

title: User Growth Manager (Singapore)
description:

1. Identify user needs and growth opportunities through user feedback, behavioral data, market trends, and major game launches.
2. Develop user growth strategies across acquisition, engagement, retention, referral, and monetization.

4. Grow global user communities, monitor user sentiment, and turn feedback into product and operational improvements.

1. 3+ years of experience in product operations, growth operations, game operations, or a related field.
